cars.name: Jana 50
cars.maps: Chernarus, Livonia, Sakhal, Nasdara (shares the motorbike spawn pool: max 25 / 12 / 12 / 30)
cars.description: Light 50cc moped added in update 1.30. Cheap to run and quick to get moving, but slow (around 70 km/h) and has no cargo storage. Top speed is approximate, from the developers' description.

cars.name: Bitrak 682
cars.maps: Chernarus, Livonia, Sakhal, Nasdara (shares the motorbike spawn pool: max 25 / 12 / 12 / 30)
cars.description: Enduro motorbike added in update 1.30. Much faster than the Jana 50 (around 130 km/h) and good off-road. Accepts left, right and front shield attachments. Has no cargo storage. Top speed is approximate, from the developers' description.

diseases.name: Silicosis
diseases.causes: Breathing sand and dust during Nasdara sandstorms without a face covering
diseases.symptoms: Coughing during sandstorms; heavy breathing and greatly reduced stamina
diseases.treatment: No medicine cures it. Leave the dust and shelter indoors; it clears over time while your immune system is in good shape (fed, hydrated, healthy)
diseases.prevention: Wear a mask or face covering in sandstorms; shelter in buildings, underground or in a vehicle
diseases.description: Respiratory illness added with the Badlands expansion (1.30). Exact exposure thresholds and timings have not been published by the developers.

diseases.name: Irritated Eyes
diseases.causes: Sand and dust in the eyes during Nasdara sandstorms without eye protection
diseases.symptoms: Impaired vision. Does not damage health and does not show the sickness icon
diseases.treatment: Use the Wash Face action at a well, pond or other water source (splashing from a bottle helps only a little)
diseases.prevention: Wear goggles (e.g. Dust Goggles) or other eye protection; a mask alone does not protect the eyes
diseases.description: Condition added with the Badlands expansion (1.30).
